fields.description: Issue features an editorial and reporting on alleged illegal gambling and a purported Miami Beach "Syndicate" tied to local officials, including activity described near the Miami courthouse and Miami police station. Continued coverage of the "Torture Doctor" series discusses Dr. Moore, including court-record references to multiple marriages and divorce filings alleging cruelty, and includes a letter involving the American Psychoanalytic Association. The issue also prints correspondence about Salvation Army fundraising and operations, a health piece on tobacco and cancer, commentary on medical costs and pneumonia treatment, and local entertainment and cultural listings (music events, nightclubs) plus notice of an Actors vs. Musicians baseball benefit at Flamingo Park.
